questions.question: Which storage component usually loses its contents when the machine loses power?
questions.explanation: Ordinary RAM is volatile and requires power to retain its contents.

questions.question: A process wants to retain a text report after it exits. Where should it write the report?
questions.explanation: A file on persistent storage can outlive the process that wrote it.

questions.question: An application repeatedly computes the same costly result. Which technique can reuse a recent result to reduce work?
questions.explanation: A cache can store a result under a key for later reuse.

questions.question: A laptop needs a copy of a project that can be recovered if its drive fails. Which practice addresses that need?

options.c: Store a verified backup on separate storage
options.d: Move files to another folder on the same drive

questions.explanation: A verified backup on separate storage can survive failure of the original drive.

questions.question: What allows two independent programs on one computer to have separate virtual address spaces?

options.d: The file extension of each program

questions.explanation: Operating systems isolate processes by giving each its own virtual address space.
